name: Cortex Context
description: Injects cited Cortex memory into OpenClaw from a live local server or a signed portable-memory bundle.

mode.label: Memory Mode
mode.help: live calls the local Cortex server. bundle verifies and searches a signed portable-memory file offline.

token.label: Cortex API Token
token.help: Use a read token for recall. Add write scope only when captureMode=user.

captureMode.label: Capture OpenClaw User Turns
captureMode.help: Off by default. user queues user turns into Cortex through its normal review pipeline.

bundlePath.label: Portable Bundle Path
bundlePath.help: Required in bundle mode. The adapter verifies this file before every changed-file reload.

expectedSigningKeyId.label: Pinned Bundle Signer
expectedSigningKeyId.help: Required in bundle mode by default. SHA-256 id of the trusted Ed25519 public key.

allowRemote.label: Allow Remote Cortex Server
allowRemote.help: Off by default to prevent bearer-token egress away from loopback.

failOpen.label: Fail Open
failOpen.help: When enabled, Cortex outages do not block the OpenClaw turn.
